name: Mexedia Società Per Azioni S.B.
summary: Mexedia Società Per Azioni S.B. is an Italian technology firm specializing in the telecommunications and business services industries. The company provides diverse technological solutions designed to streamline interactions between businesses and their clientele. Its core mission involves leveraging automation and cutting-edge tools to enhance sales processes, optimize marketing efforts, and improve customer support functions. Established in 2017, the organization adopted its current name, Mexedia Società Per Azioni S.B., in May 2022, having previously operated as Airtime Partecipazioni S.p.A. Its principal operations are conducted from its headquarters in Rome, Italy.
